entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
....For the Respondents No.2 & 3.
Having heard learned advocates for the parties and considering the nature of the order impugned in
this writ petition, I am of the considered view that the writ petition cannot be decided without
inviting affidavits.

Let affidavit-in-opposition be filed by 8th May, 2014; reply thereto, if any, may be filed by 12th May,
2014.
ACO Put up the writ petition for final disposal on 13th May, 2014 before the regular hearing Bench subject to convenience of the learned Judge.

There shall be an interim order directing the respondent to test the samples of Canola oil in accordance with law for the purpose of ascertaining whether the quality thereof conforms to the standard mentioned in the Food Safety and Standard Act and the rules framed thereunder.
The report of testing shall be enclosed with the affidavit-in-opposition to be filed by the respondents.

(Dipankar Datta,J.)
